title: A walk through the woods
evenTitle: He hasn't been served yet. / He will be served soon.
evenTitleZh: 还没有人来侍候他。／很快会有人来侍候他的。

words.zh: 扔，抛（过去式 threw，过去分词 thrown）

lines.en: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
lines.zh: 我住在一个由美丽的树林环绕的古老小镇上。

lines.en: It is a famous beauty spot.
lines.zh: 这是一个著名的风景胜地。

lines.en: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
lines.zh: 每逢星期天，有许许多多人从城里来观赏我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。

lines.en: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
lines.zh: 游客已被告知要保持树林的整洁。

lines.en: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees,
lines.zh: 树下都已设置了废物筐，

lines.en: but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
lines.zh: 但是人们仍到处扔垃圾。

lines.en: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
lines.zh: 上星期三我到树林里去散步。

lines.en: What I saw made me very sad.
lines.zh: 我所见到的一切使我非常难过。

lines.en: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
lines.zh: 我数了一下，有7辆旧汽车和3个旧冰箱。

lines.en: and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
lines.zh: 而满地都是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的空罐头盒。

lines.en: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said,
lines.zh: 在垃圾堆中我发现了一块牌子，上面写着：

lines.en: 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
lines.zh: “凡在此树林里丢弃垃圾者，将依法处置。”
